exit: 0
--- stdout
List the block classes, or describe one with its resolved ports

Usage: oce catalog [OPTIONS] [CLASS]

Arguments:
  [CLASS]  A class path (`CDL.Reals.Hysteresis`); every class when absent

Options:
      --json                Print the JSON report instead of text
      --render <RENDER>     When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --param <NAME=VALUE>  A parameter value for port resolution (`nin=3`, `k_2=1.5`); repeatable
  -h, --help                Print help
  -V, --version             Print version
--- stderr
